en: Black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a rural village landscape with fields in the foreground, dense trees, and a cluster of houses with pitched roofs; a church tower is visible among the buildings. In the center, printed text reads "Naunhof bei Großenhain". The lower image shows a stone village church with a small tower and arched windows, surrounded by a cemetery with numerous gravestones. In the lower left corner of the photo is the word "Kirche", and in the lower right a small serial number.
